claim_boundary: Commercial and industrial loan balances combine credit supply, borrower demand, repayments and bank reporting effects; they are not a direct measure of investable liquidity or a Bitcoin predictor. Strict acceleration in their year-over-year growth may proxy broadening business credit, but contraction, crisis borrowing and monetary reactions can reverse the sign. This supports one audit only.

primary_sources.title: Commercial and Industrial Loans, All Commercial Banks
primary_sources.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
primary_sources.use: Official monthly seasonally adjusted C&I loan-balance identity and free present-vintage CSV source.

primary_sources.title: H.8 Assets and Liabilities of Commercial Banks in the United States
primary_sources.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
primary_sources.use: Official release, reporting and revision boundary for commercial-bank asset data.

independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_household_income: BUSLOANS is a commercial-bank business-credit balance. DSPIC96 measured household after-tax real income; its closed result cannot be reopened or combined with this one.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_central_bank_liquid: BUSLOANS is neither the Federal Reserve balance sheet, reserves, TGA, ON RRP nor stablecoin supply. Those closed families cannot be rescued.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.prohibited_rescue: Do not add total loans, consumer loans, standards surveys, deposits, spreads, rates, levels, absolute growth, smoothing, alternate lags, thresholds, direction inversion or another factor after access.

adversarial_prior: Loan balances can rise because distressed firms draw credit lines rather than because risk-bearing capacity improves.
Bank-reporting revisions and mergers can change present-vintage history.
Credit expansion can lag financial markets or precede tighter monetary policy.
U.S. business credit may have weak relevance for global crypto demand.
A long-cash rule can reduce drawdown only by forfeiting upside.
